Class LiveRegion

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.terminal.LiveRegion
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class LiveRegion extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A repainting block of rows at the bottom of a terminal stream.

The region is repainted by a background ticker at a fixed rate so spinners and elapsed times keep moving between events. Permanent output is written above the region with printAbove(String); the region is cleared on close(). Callers describe the current rows through a LiveRegion.Frame and keep their own state under their own lock; the region serialises rendering internally.

When the stream is not interactive the region draws nothing; callers print plain lines themselves.
